summary: First research night for Craze & Crash (demand). Added 4 sourced topics from this month's breakouts: Pizza Hut vs Domino's (a long film and a Short), Gillette's $8B writedown, and Novo Nordisk's Ozempic rise and fall as a Short.
why: Nothing is published yet, so demand comes from the niche scan: 653K views on a 10.8K channel for Gillette (60x), 257K on 10.8K for Pizza Hut (24x), 469K on 36.1K for the Novo Short (13x). Business war had 1 topic in the feed and no Short; brand backlash is the recipe's gap. Tata Nano was skipped (India-only brand under the 1M a local topic needs), Prime too (open lawsuits).

findings.title: Gillette: 653K views on a 10.8K channel
findings.detail: P&G wrote $8.0B off Gillette in 2019 and blamed currency, Dollar Shave Club and Harry's, and men shaving less, not the ad. Topic added.

findings.title: Pizza Hut sold for $2.7B after Domino's took the crown
findings.detail: US share 16.9% to 12.1% (2015-2025) while Domino's went 14.2% to 23.4%. A long topic and a Short.

findings.title: Novo Nordisk shed about $475B from a $650B+ peak
findings.detail: The Ozempic maker's fall, as a Short (reference: 469K on a 36.1K channel).

findings.title: Long Shorts raise the ceiling, not the median
findings.detail: 9 of 19 on-niche breakout Shorts run 100-180 s, but that band's median is 2,964 views vs 15,920 at 35-60 s. Added to the waiting length challenger.

changes.title: 4 topics in the feed
changes.detail: research/topics.json: 2 Shorts (scores 6.97 and 6.71), 2 long topics for Scout.
